behaviors.behavior: Multi-record single response dedups to one call
Repeated Stop firing overwrites with an identical, non-doubled result
Call outside any run_id is labelled unphased, not dropped
Call before the run's first phase mark is unphased, not misattributed
Cost sums each token type at its own rate (cache-read != input rate)
Unrecognized model id (exact + date-stripped both fail) -> cost_usd: null, unpriced_model: true, raw counts kept
Versioned model id resolves via date-suffix stripping to the correct family price
Aggregate cost_usd = priced subtotal; cost_complete: false whenever unpriced_calls > 0
Malformed record (missing requestId/usage/model) is skipped, counted, never fabricated
estimate_context_pressure.py --source context-cost reads the current session's file at the same 120/300 thresholds; default source unchanged
track_tool_calls.py and its hooks.json registration are unmodified by this diff
Readiness check flags unset/oversized autoCompactWindow; effort level reported honestly (warn when not passed, never fabricated)
finalize_iterate.py folds calls/context/cost/per-phase breakdown into work_completed, additive like phase_timings, stamped with measured_through/measured_at
Hook never raises out of main() -- a broken transcript logs to stderr and still returns 0
Hook writes the per-session file -> statusline script reads it -> pressure-estimate (--source context-cost) consumes it, end to end, real files, no mocking
Writer (Stop hook) and same-process-class reader (statusline) resolve the SAME session id via resolve_session_id -- payload wins when present, env only as fallback
The F5b fold's populated case (real compute_summary output, not just absence) actually reaches work_completed.context_cost
A malformed summary file (non-object JSON, or invalid JSON) never loses the work_completed event
The Stop hook resolves run_id via phase_quality.pointer_run_id (live, session-matched pointer), never the raw env var or the broader resolve_run_id fallback chain
The Stop hook's project_root resolution prefers the session's active iterate worktree over the naive resolve_project_root() cwd fallback
.shipwright/compliance/context-cost/ is gitignored, matching every sibling run-scoped sidecar
A stale, project-global run id is never picked up by a later, unrelated session in the same tree; calls degrade to unphased rather than misattributed
Unpriced calls record which distinct model id(s) produced them (unpriced_models, sorted + deduplicated), reaching the persisted work_completed.context_cost fold
TTL-split cache-write detection keys on the split field's PRESENCE, not its value's truthiness -- an explicit-zero split still wins over a nonzero aggregate
A session id that would collide with another on-disk is rejected by the shared session_summary_path validator
A transiently-missing transcript file on a LATER Stop firing never overwrites the prior summary with an empty one
A versioned/dated model snapshot id passed to the readiness check resolves via the same exact-then-date-stripped policy compute_cost_usd uses
Cost is accumulated at full precision, rounded exactly once at the point a total is finalized -- many sub-microdollar calls sum to a nonzero total, not zero
A Stop firing with neither a payload session_id nor SHIPWRIGHT_SESSION_ID set skips the write entirely rather than pooling under a fixed "unknown" placeholder
A transcript record with a wrong-TYPE (not merely missing) requestId/model/token-count field never aborts the whole transcript's accounting
